title: Entry Requirements of the Corbett Net Terms Tiers
content:
**Conditions of credit — Commercial Credit Account.** Each terms tier has an entry gate an applicant or an upgrading account must meet in full.

### Entry gate per tier

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Years in business, at least | 0 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 10 |
| PAYDEX score, at least | 0 | 60 | 70 | 75 | 78 | 80 |
| Trailing 12 month purchases with Corbett, USD, at least | 0.00 | 5000.00 | 50000.00 | 250000.00 | 1000000.00 | 5000000.00 |
| Personal guarantee required | yes | no | no | no | no | no |
| Financial statements required | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |

### Application terms per tier

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days within which a credit application is decided | 2 | 2 | 3 | 5 | 10 | 15 |
| Supplier trade references required with the application | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 2 | 0 |

### Notes

- Only the Corbett Net 10 Starter Account requires a personal guarantee; the Corbett Net 45 Business, Net 60 Corporate and Net 90 Strategic tiers require financial statements.
- The Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account requires 0 trade references and the Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account 2; every other tier requires 3.
- *Hypothetical:* an applicant with 4 years in business, a PAYDEX score of 72 and 60000.00 of trailing 12 month purchases meets the gate of the Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account in full, and not that of the Corbett Net 45 Business Account (5 years, 75, 250000.00, financial statements).
